svg.text: Asks in the terminal, read-only evidence, nothing runs without your yes. Conceptual view: no addresses or environment names.
Read the plan before it runs
Runs the task in a fixed order
Pauses to ask you when needed
Starts on demand, stops when idle
Used by triage and the Guard
One trace per step of each task
No cluster keys in the agents
Network rules: only what is needed
Read-only by default: nothing changes your cluster or your repository
Claude Code runs only the exact prompt you approved
Agents never hold your cluster access; the laptop runs the read-only commands
No public address: you reach the orchestrator through a secure tunnel
Secrets are removed before anything leaves the laptop and before any prompt
Called by Claude Code on your laptop
1 You ask the question in the terminal
2 The Guard checks the request and your rules
3 Triage picks the workflow and says how sure it is
4 The knowledge agent finds the runbooks (read-only)
5 The evidence collector gathers read-only facts
7 You read the exact prompt and type yes
8 Claude Code runs it in your repository
9 Every step is traced for the dashboard
No model runs on your laptop. Nothing changes your cluster. Traces contain timings, never content.
